extracted.name: Carrot Ginger Soup
extracted.description: This comforting carrot ginger soup is made with fresh ginger and seasoned with curry powder for the perfect savory-sweet soup on chilly evenings.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 pounds carrots, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces
1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, or more to taste
1 tablespoon snipped fresh chives, or to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, ginger, and garlic; sauté until softened, 15 to 20 minutes.
Add broth, carrots, and wine; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, until carrots are tender, about 40 minutes.
Puree with an immersion blender until carrots are no longer chunky and soup has a thick consistency. Add lemon juice, salt, pepper, and curry powder.
Serve in large mugs with chives and fresh black pepper.
